licence.afterExpiry.value: A late renewal application can be made. Within 30 days of expiry, if granted, the licence is deemed to have continued and no fine applies. After 30 days, if granted, it is deemed continued but an automatic fine applies, which the Registrar may waive. A licensee not renewing must notify the Registrar before expiry of its intention and wind-down steps. The Registrar may strike a Registered Person off the Public Register if it is not carrying on business or is in contravention of the Law or Regulations, after publishing a notice of intention. No fixed day count after expiry at which strike-off happens was found.
licence.afterExpiry.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), late renewal (DIFC Operating Regulations 2.9.3 and 2.9.4; Operating Law Art. 9(11), 9(12), 32(1) and 32(2); CONFIRMED; amounts left out); https://assets.difc.com/v1/media/edge/images/dubaiintern0078-difcexperie96c5-production-3253/media/project/difcexperiences/difc/difcwebsite/documents/difc_docs/annex-b_operating-regulations.pdf ; https://www.difc.com/business/laws-and-regulations/legal-database/difc-laws/operating-law-difc-law-no-7-2018 ; https://edge.sitecorecloud.io/dubaiintern0078-difcexperie96c5-production-3253/media/project/difcexperiences/difc/difcwebsite/documents/laws--regulations/operating_-law_no_7_of_2018_updated_2024.pdf
